_comment: REFERENCE ONLY. The live agent card is auto-built by Strands from the Agent's name/description + its @tool skills in bridge.py and served at /.well-known/agent-card.json; its 'url' is auto-populated from AGENTCORE_RUNTIME_URL once deployed. This shows the shape to expect for the remote-agent registration step. Do not hand-edit and ship this as the card.
name: nimbus-security-review-agent
description: Read-only security reviewer. Given a code or configuration change implicated in an incident, runs an AWS Security Agent differential code review and returns the security findings (severity, risk type, location, confidence). Use when a DevOps investigation's root cause is a code or configuration change and you need an exposure assessment.

skills.name: Start a differential security review
skills.description: Uploads a unified diff and starts an AWS Security Agent differential review, returning a job id immediately (does not block).

skills.name: Get security review findings
skills.description: Checks an in-progress review and returns findings once complete (name, risk level, risk type, confidence).
